recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future operation maturity changes should set OperationDefinition-level structuredefinition-fmm metadata, or the active generator input that produces it, rather than adding redundant narrative or reopening the already-reconciled FHIR-15974 value decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17499 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core FHIR-I issue asking for a way to assign FMM to operations. Its resolution said to do it, and the Jira follow-up recorded that an FMM column in the spreadsheet was already done.
initial_application: The linked 2018 Zulip thread shows Eric Haas asking how to assign FMM to core Observation $stats and $lastn, with Grahame Grieve instructing editors to add an fmm column in the operations tab. Commit c82cf3a67b explicitly mentioned GF#17499 and added the operations-tab fmm column with FMM 3 for stats and lastn; bf5f44dfbf and 20e8b020b4 preserved the values while tracking trial-use status.
additional_context: The 2021 source rework converted the old spreadsheet operation rows into standalone OperationDefinition XML that carries structuredefinition-fmm extensions. Observation and OperationDefinition are active in fhir.ini, and the Observation operations list references both current OperationDefinition files. FHIR-15974, the concrete Observation operation maturity issue, is already reconciled on the combined branch, and FHIR-14295 resolved that operation-list FMM display is unnecessary because each operation has its own page and maturity level.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has operation-level FMM assignment through OperationDefinition metadata, and the historical motivating operations are active build inputs with FMM 3.

related_jiras.note: Observation $stats/$lastn were the concrete use case for the missing operation FMM mechanism; the value/status decision is already represented on the combined branch.
Resolved - No Change because individual operation pages carry their own maturity level, preventing this seed from requiring a separate operations-list display column.
